result.summary: Meadow Works say they finished the shower job (event 010). Their email says an invoice is attached, but I can't see one in the CRM, and the system couldn't read the email (event 009). I moved the ticket from scheduling to closeout. I asked Meadow Works to resend the invoice and say whether cold water now comes through, and asked the tenant to confirm the cold side works. The ticket is on hold until 4 June. Nothing gets paid until the invoice has been checked.
result.situation: The tenant reported no water from the cold side of the shower, so the hot side was sometimes too hot to use. The landlord approved attendance with no amount set (approval 31). Meadow Works was assigned, and after one reminder they said the engineer cleaned and greased the shower, which fixed 'the main problem', and that an invoice is attached. I can't see any attachment.

actions_taken.description: Loaded ticket, profiles, events and approvals
actions_taken.result: Stage was scheduling. Approval 31 approved with no amount. No attachments, holds or property history visible.
Completion report 0.56, invoice 0.44, needs a person to review 0.68, safety concern 0.04

actions_taken.description: Moved stage from scheduling to closeout because the contractor reports the work is done
Emailed Meadow Works asking them to resend the invoice with the reference and say whether cold water now flows
Emailed the tenant asking her to confirm the cold side works, with a safety tip and a check-back date of 4 June
Put the ticket on hold waiting for the invoice and the tenant's confirmation
Noted on Meadow Works' record that they didn't confirm booking after a reminder and that their invoice didn't arrive

escalation.reason: The contractor and tenant can answer what's missing (the invoice and whether the fix worked). No dispute or safety risk at present.
escalation.recommendation: If the invoice doesn't arrive by the follow-up date, or doesn't match Meadow Works, this property or a reasonable amount for the approved attendance, pass it to a person to check before paying.

unverified: The work being done and the problem being fixed: only the contractor says so
Whether the cold supply itself was restored. 'Main problem' and 'temperature issue' may not cover the reported lack of cold water
The invoice amount, payee and contents: no invoice is visible
failures: The invoice the contractor says is attached isn't visible in the CRM, and the system couldn't read their email (event 009)
risks_or_red_flags: The landlord approved with no amount, so any invoice may need the landlord's sign-off on the cost
'Resolved the main problem' suggests something may still be outstanding
Possible scald risk if the cold side still doesn't work
result.final_status: In closeout, on hold (hold 154) waiting for the contractor's invoice and the tenant's confirmation

next_follow_up.what: Chase Meadow Works for the invoice and the tenant for confirmation. When the invoice arrives, check payee, property and amount before going further; close the ticket once the tenant confirms.

judgement.why_this_decision: Event 010 is a completion report, so the work stage is behind. But there's no invoice to check, and it's not certain the reported fault (no cold water) was fixed. The contractor and tenant can answer both, so I asked them rather than escalating.

alternatives_considered.why_not: There's no invoice and no tenant confirmation, and 'main problem' is vague
Nothing is in dispute yet, and the missing pieces can be got by asking
The contractor reports the work is done, so the stage was behind the evidence

checks_performed: Contractor matches the one assigned (Meadow Works)
Safety: low, but added a tip to test the water temperature
assumptions: Event 010 comes from Meadow Works, the assigned contractor
